name: phi-redactor
description: De-identify PHI in clinical text and documents entirely on the local machine. Removes patient and provider names, dates, MRNs, SSNs, phone numbers, addresses, emails, and other identifiers, replacing each with a category tag. Uses Microsoft Presidio plus a clinical NER transformer (obi/deid_roberta_i2b2) that catches names in free-text prose that general models miss. Reads .txt, .md, .pdf, .docx, .xlsx, and .pptx. Model libraries are forced into offline mode before they load, so a redaction run makes no network call. Also offers a reversible mode that writes a local key, so text can be de-identified, processed by another tool, then restored.
